home.heroLead: Castle Packaging manufactures kraft, recycled and virgin paper bags, paper covers and paper tissues — with custom printing available on every product.
home.feature1Text: We make paper bags, covers and tissues in-house, so lead times and pricing stay in our control.
home.feature2Text: Add your logo and branding to paper bags, covers or tissues — for retail, food service or corporate gifting.
home.feature3Text: Choose the material that fits your product and sustainability goals, from recycled kraft to virgin cellulose fibre.
home.ctaHeadline: Have a custom order in mind?
home.ctaText: Tell us your product, quantity and printing requirements — we'll get back with a quote.

about.whoWeAreText: Castle Packaging manufactures paper bags and digitally prints on finished products — boxes, bagasse, cloth and jute — from a single piece, for businesses, events and family occasions.
about.manufactureText: Paper bags in brown kraft (recycled) and white (virgin) paper, plus paper covers and tissues. Full-colour digital printing on finished items — paper and board, bagasse, cloth and jute — with no minimum order.
about.serveText: Retail and clothing brands, food and beverage businesses, hospitality, corporate gifting, event managers, and families celebrating weddings, birthdays, poojas and festivals — plus jute, cloth and paper bag makers who need printing.
about.missionText: To make reliable, good-quality paper bags, and to let businesses, events and families put their own name and design on packaging and gifts — in any quantity, delivered on time.
about.visionText: To be Bengaluru’s most trusted name for paper bags and made-to-order printing — known for quality, dependability and fast turnaround.
about.value1Text: Our bags are made of paper — brown kraft (recycled) or white (virgin) — so you can choose what suits your product and your budget.
about.value2Text: Digital printing from a single piece, so your packaging and gifts can carry your logo, name or design — not just your product.
about.value3Text: As manufacturers, we work directly with you on specification, quantity and timelines, rather than routing your order through a reseller.
about.todayHeadline: A Bengaluru paper bag manufacturer and digital printer
about.todayText1: Today, Castle Packaging is a proprietorship based in Bengaluru. We manufacture paper bags in brown kraft (recycled) and white (virgin) paper, and we digitally print on finished items — paper and board, bagasse, cloth and jute — from a single piece. Rush and last-minute orders are welcome.
about.todayText2: We also print for trade customers: jute, cloth and paper bag makers who stitch or make the bags and need them printed. From the first piece to repeat production, we work directly with you on design, quantity and delivery date.

quote.headline: Get a Quote
quote.subtext: Tell us what you need and when. We'll reply with pricing and lead time.
